verdict.rationale: Programmatic deployment control is a fair question for an infrastructure-as-code tool, but the evidence only documents CLI-based automation: -auto-approve, saved plan files, and -json machine-readable output. Shelling out to the CLI is still driving it through the CLI, so it is a building block rather than an application-level SDK or API. The documented MCP server only gives AI models access to provider docs, modules and policies, not deployment control, and no deployment API or SDK appears in the evidence.
